# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This site is essentially a living lab notebook; a running collection of how I work with data over time. I like to think of this as a mix between a portfolio and a working record. 

*I am slowly migrating all my existing work to this site - bear with me!*

It brings together my approaches, projects, and things I have learned along the way. Everything here is built openly and documented as I go. The focus is on my **approach** and **processes** to conducting transparent and reproducible research, rather than on particular findings. 

If you find something useful, have any questions, notice something is off/spotted an error, or just want to chat, feel free to reach out! 

You can find me on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/amelia-henry/) or you [email](mailto:amelia.henry@sydney.edu.au) me.
